name: Woodland Lights at Countryside Park
when_note: Nov 27 to 29, Dec 4 to 6, Dec 11 to 13 and Dec 18 to 23, 6 to 9 PM, gate closes at 8:30 PM
cost: Free lights; Santa visits $10 per family
paras: Washington Township Recreation presents Woodland Lights for its 35th anniversary at Countryside Park, 895 Miamisburg-Centerville Rd. The remaining 2026 dates are November 27 to 29, December 4 to 6, December 11 to 13 and December 18 to 23, from 6 to 9 PM, and the gate closes at 8:30 PM.

Countryside Park is under construction this year, so the lights are free for everyone and guests stroll an abbreviated path that enters beside the east road near the Fitness Center. The township says it is fitting in as many lights and moments as it can along the way.

New this year, families register for a time slot to visit Santa. A visit costs $10 per family, families with more than six people may want to book more than one slot, and registration is online through the township recreation system.
tip: Register for a Santa time slot online before you go, since visits are by reservation.
